# Building for Sideloading (SideStore)

Produces an unsigned `.ipa` for installation via [SideStore](https://sidestore.io) — no paid Apple Developer account required. SideStore re-signs the app with your Apple ID on install and refreshes automatically.

## Prerequisites

- macOS with Xcode installed (you never need to open the GUI)
- Bun installed globally

## Build

```sh
sh build-sideload.sh
```

Output: `dist/smartpage.ipa`

The script runs `expo prebuild`, resolves Swift Package dependencies, archives without signing, then manually zips the `.app` into an IPA.

## Sideloading via SideStore

1. Install SideStore on your device — follow the [SideStore docs](https://docs.sidestore.io/docs/intro)
2. Transfer `dist/smartpage.ipa` to your device (AirDrop, Files app, etc.)
3. Open SideStore → tap **+** → select the `.ipa`
4. SideStore signs and installs it using your Apple ID

SideStore refreshes the 7-day certificate automatically in the background over Wi-Fi.

## Alternative: EAS Local Builds

`eas build --local` runs the same pipeline on your machine. It requires a one-time EAS project registration (touches Expo's servers) but handles signing config and `xcodebuild` flags automatically. Local builds do **not** consume cloud build credits — they are unlimited.

```sh
bunx eas-cli build --platform ios --local
```

See the [EAS local builds docs](https://docs.expo.dev/build-reference/local-builds/) for setup.
